questionSnapshot.question: Which rabbit starred in Walt Disney's theatrical cartoon shorts of 1927–1928?

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Challenged earlier Disney animals and the original cat distractor giveaway. Final options are four rabbits, and the premise now pins theatrical shorts to 1927–1928. The Oswald series record excludes the three other rabbit names.
